name: xtandard/image
description: Typed URL builder (imgproxy, /info, /video, HLS/DASH, query dialect), signing, source encryption and PSR-18 HTTP client for xtandard-image.

suggest.symfony/http-client: A PSR-18 client that is also a PSR-17 factory (Symfony\Component\HttpClient\Psr18Client, with nyholm/psr7)
